_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The base rate is brutal — 0 of 52 windows moved ±2+ — and without institutional ETF flows there is no fuel to climb the ladder, so Denial holds until a confirmed breaker arrives.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst says HOLD/Disbelief next; narrative implies a directional recovery toward Hope. The split is real: the narrative is pattern-anchored while the analyst is factor-anchored, and the analyst's evidence (ETF 0 vs 55, funding normalized, VIX 62) is stronger.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows break above 30 and funding stays below 40 with BTC holding $62K — institutional return validates a climb to Disbelief/Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 20 with VIX above 70 and BTC breaks $60K — confirms this was Panic/Anxiety masquerading as Denial and the call was one rung too high
